'''D9-S2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] belonging to [[Zaryos]]. During the evacuation of the [[Jedi Colony]] from [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], Zaryos explained to [[Nadia Grell]], [[Tau Idair]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] that the colonists could not leave until they had downloaded their data to D9-S2, emphasizing that they found out how to grow crops in a radioactive wasteland, and that such information would be invaluable to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Mounting a Defense|Ossus}}</ref>
